verses.gurmukhi: ਸਬਦ ਕੀ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਅਸਫੁਰਤਿ ਹੁਇ ਤੁਰਤ ਹੀ ਜੁਰਤ ਹੈ ਸਾਧ ਸੰਗ ਮੁਰਤ ਨਾਹੀ ॥
verses.translit_en: sabadh kee surat asafurat hui turat hee jurat hai saadh sa(n)g murat naahee ||

en.bdb: In the company of godly people, the mind readily focuses on the divine word. That results in perpetual and uninterrupted meditation on Naam.

verses.gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਪਰਤੀਤ ਕੀ ਰੀਤਿ ਹਿਤ ਚੀਤ ਕਰਿ ਜੀਤ ਮਨ ਜਗਤ ਮਨ ਦੁਰਤ ਨਾਹੀ ॥
verses.translit_en: prem parateet kee reet hit cheet kar jeet man jagat man dhurat naahee ||

en.bdb: As a result of union with holy gathering, the mundane distractions of daily life do not disturb any more. It adheres to the loving code with faith and confidence.

verses.gurmukhi: ਕਾਮ ਨਿਹਕਾਮ ਨਿਹਕਰਮ ਹੁਇ ਕਰਮ ਕਰਿ ਆਸ ਨਿਰਾਸ ਹੁਇ ਝਰਤ ਨਾਹੀ ॥
verses.translit_en: kaam nihakaam nihakaram hui karam kar aas niraas hui jharat naahee ||

en.bdb: By virtue of keeping company of holy men, a God worshipping Guru-conscious person remains free of worldly desires despite living in their influence. He claims no credit for any deed performed. He remains bereft of all expectations and hopes and feels no distress for anything.

verses.gurmukhi: ਗਿਆਨ ਗੁਰ ਧਿਆਨ ਉਰ ਮਾਨਿ ਪੂਰਨ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਜਗਤ ਮਹਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਮਤਿ ਛਰਤ ਨਾਹੀ ॥੧੪੫॥
verses.translit_en: giaan gur dhiaan ur maan pooran braham jagat meh bhagat mat chharat naahee ||145||

en.bdb: By the virtue of holy congregation, with the instilling of Lords knowledge and perception in the mind, and feeling His presence around, such a devotee is never cheated or tricked in the world. (145)
